global.title: Crypto Market Update: Strategy, Coinbase Post Major Q2 ...
global.summary: Markets pulled back as major crypto firms reported losses and debate intensified over U.S. legislation that could loosen oversight of decentralized platforms. The report also highlights warnings from law enforcement about fraud and illicit finance risks.
global.whyItMatters: Financial anxiety, speculation, and consumer losses affect families in the pews; this is a useful window into stewardship, trust, and economic pressure.

canadian.title: Pete Hoekstra says Canada, U.S. aligned on Gordie Howe bridge ahead of opening | Watch News Videos Online
canadian.summary: Canada and the U.S. are presenting a cooperative front ahead of the Gordie Howe bridge opening, while the broader report also points to economic growth, labour uncertainty, product recalls, and ongoing trade diversification concerns.
canadian.whyItMatters: Cross-border infrastructure and trade stability shape affordability, jobs, and public confidence—important context for pastoral care and community conversations.

canadian.title: Vancouver hosts Canada’s last World Cup game | Watch News Videos Online
canadian.summary: Attention remains on Vancouver’s World Cup role, with the broader coverage also surfacing B.C. energy developments, manufacturing uncertainty, and international tensions affecting Canada’s outlook.
canadian.whyItMatters: Major events can unify communities and open ministry opportunities around hospitality, civic engagement, and witness in the public square.

local.title: B.C.’s wildfire situation continues to flare up, with more blazes and evacuations | Fraser Valley Today | Everything Fraser Valley
local.summary: B.C. added nearly 30 new wildfires in 24 hours, with fresh evacuation orders and alerts near Kelowna as wind and thunderstorms worsen conditions. Officials are urging residents across the province to prepare to leave quickly if needed.
local.whyItMatters: This has immediate implications for prayer, preparedness, pastoral care, and possible support for displaced families across B.C.

persecutedChurch.title: Rising Attacks on Christians in Jerusalem - CNN
persecutedChurch.summary: CNN highlights growing attacks against Christians in Jerusalem, adding fresh visibility to pressures facing historic Christian communities in the Holy Land.
persecutedChurch.whyItMatters: It is a timely prompt to pray for vulnerable believers and to help congregations remember the global church beyond Canada.

persecutedChurch.title: ‘Antisemitism is our new reality’: 2025 was deadliest year in more than three decades - Ynetnews
persecutedChurch.summary: A new J7 report says 2025 was the deadliest year for antisemitic violence in more than 30 years across major Jewish communities, even where some annual incident totals declined from the previous year.
persecutedChurch.whyItMatters: Pastors should be alert to rising hatred, teach clearly on human dignity, and model solidarity with neighbours facing fear and violence.

leadership.title: Frontiers | Ethical leadership and sustainable employee wellbeing: the roles of emotional energy, moral signals, and psychological resources
leadership.summary: This research argues that ethical leadership supports lasting wellbeing not just through values talk, but by shaping healthier emotional demands and organizational patterns.
leadership.whyItMatters: A helpful reminder that healthy ministry leadership requires more than good intentions; it also means designing church life in ways that reduce chronic strain.

goodNews.title: 32 good news stories from 2025 you might have missed...
goodNews.summary: This roundup gathers hopeful stories, including inclusive community care, justice reforms, sustainable innovation, and major philanthropic commitments for health and education.
goodNews.whyItMatters: Good news helps balance a heavy news cycle and offers illustrations of common grace, compassion, and constructive service.
